data.name: One-on-One Individual Stand-Up Paddle Lesson
data.headline: Learn to paddle in calm, protected waters just steps from The Royal Hawaiian.
data.description: Learn or advance your skills in stand-up paddling with a personalized one-on-one lesson. Whether you're a beginner mastering balance, paddling, and turning, or an advanced paddler ready to catch waves, this lesson will be tailored to your skill level. Paddle over the reef and keep an eye out for turtles as you explore Waikīkī's calm waters.
data.highlights:
- Private one-on-one stand-up paddling lesson with an expert instructor
- Choose between beginner or advanced instruction
- Paddle in the beautiful waters of Waikīkī with a chance to see turtles
data.itinerary:
- 15 minutes of safety instruction on the sand
- 1 hour of stand-up paddling with personalized coaching

meeting_point.address: Royal Hawaiian Hotel, 2259 Kalākaua Ave., Honolulu, HI 96815

data.what_is_included:
- Stand-up paddleboard
- Rash guard
- 15-minute safety briefing
data.what_is_not_included:
- Towel
- Storage for personal items or valuables
data.cancellation_summary: Submit cancellation requests 48 hours prior for a refund.
data.cancellation_notes:
If you wish to change or cancel your booking, please submit your request via e-mail to info@waikikibeachservices.com at least 48 hours before an activity/rental. No-shows or cancellation requests received within 48 hours will not be eligible for refund.

Please allow up to 10 business days for refunds to process between banking institutions.

data.health_and_safety_notes:
Your safety and the safety of our staff are our highest priorities. All participants, including minors, must complete an electronic liability waiver before participating in any Waikīkī Beach Services activity or rental. A link to the waiver will be included in your confirmation email. We recommend completing all waivers before your scheduled activity to help expedite check-in.

Some activities and rentals have minimum age requirements. Please provide accurate participant ages when booking. Guests who do not meet the age requirement or appear to be under the influence of drugs or alcohol will not be permitted to participate, and no refund will be issued.

Please do not leave personal belongings unattended on the beach or at the pool. Limited storage is available for shoes and towels, but valuables should be left in a secure location. Waikīkī Beach Services and its staff are not responsible for lost, stolen, or damaged personal property.
data.faqs:
- **Do I need prior stand-up paddling or surfing experience?**
No, our Waikīkī Beach stand-up paddle lessons are perfect for beginners. We can tailor your lesson to meet your paddling level. 

- **Will all the equipment be provided?**
Yes, all equipment, including a stand-up paddleboard, paddle, and rash guard, will be provided.

- **Are children allowed to participate?**
No. Guests only 13 years of age or older may participate in a stand-up paddle lesson. 

- **We have more than one person and wish to book multiple one-on-one lessons at the same time slot., but we do not see availability online. Can you help?**
Please email us at info@waikikibeachservices.com with 1) The number of students (over 13 years old), 2) Preferred date and time of your lesson (choose three) 3) Your full contact information (email address & cell phone number). Once we have received your message, we will contact you within one business day. 

- **How far is the walk to the water? Will I have to carry equipment?** 
Waikīkī Beach Services at the Royal Hawaiian is located right on the beach. The water is feet away from where you will check in for your lesson. No carrying equipment long distances, no cutting into your time in the water.
